# Statista

> > Statista is a leading statistics portal providing data, market insights, and infographics across business, economics, demographics, health, and consumer trends worldwide.

Statista aggregates statistical data from thousands of sources, covering topics from e-commerce and industrial production to public health and global economics. The platform serves researchers, businesses, and journalists with visualizations and comprehensive statistics on markets, countries, and social trends.

## Key Topics

- Market statistics and business intelligence
- E-commerce and consumer trends
- Second-hand commerce and resale markets
- COVID-19 pandemic data and health statistics
- Global economic indicators
- Country-specific data (United States, China, Germany, France)
- Industrial production and commodities
- Demographic analysis and age groups
- Sustainable shopping and recommerce
- C2C marketplaces (eBay, Alibaba, Xianyu)
- Infographics and data visualization
- Wealth distribution and inequality
- Travel and tourism statistics
- Agricultural production data

## E-Commerce & Consumer Markets

- [Second-hand e-commerce - statistics & facts](https://www.statista.com/topics/9448/second-hand-e-commerce/): Statistics on second-hand e-commerce, resale markets, and platforms like eBay

## Infographics & Data Visualizations

- [Infografik: Immer mehr Kinder infizieren sich mit COVID-19](https://de.statista.com/infografik/21676/anteil-der-corona-infektionen-in-deutschland-nach-altersgruppen/): COVID-19 infection rates by age groups in Germany infographic
- [Infografik: Weltweiter Reichtum - Vermögensverteilung](https://de.statista.com/infografik/1824/reichtumsverteilung-weltweit/): Global wealth distribution infographic showing top 1% owns 40% of wealth
- [Infografik: Wohin reisen die Deutschen am liebsten?](https://de.statista.com/infografik/30492/anzahl-der-reisen-aus-deutschland-nach-ziellaendern/): German travel destinations infographic showing Austria and Italy as top picks

## Industry & Production Statistics

- [U.S. potato production by state 2025](https://www.statista.com/statistics/382166/us-potato-production-by-state/): U.S. potato production statistics by state, led by Idaho and Washington
- [Ethylene production capacity globally 2023](https://www.statista.com/statistics/1067372/global-ethylene-production-capacity/): Global ethylene production capacity statistics for petrochemical industry
